title: Mood
heading: How you
lede: A mood diary, not a report card. It never enters any average and never changes your scores.
chartLabel: Mood over time, on a scale from 1 to 5
blendNote: Moods you add to journal entries count too, with half the weight of the mood of the day. A day with only journal moods shows their average.
gapsNote: The small ticks at the bottom are days without an entry: the line breaks, it does not drop to zero.
noEntries: No entries in this period yet.
